notes.title: Short Games Showcase + Update
notes.content:
[h3][b]The [url="https://store.steampowered.com/curator/43212066/sale/shortgamesshowcase2025"]Short Games Showcase[/url] is here![/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29776081/fc74f71276bd0f4e8c206d9fa196ea536828023d.png"][/img]Have you found yourself quoting the much-memed, "[i]I Want Shorter Games With Worse Graphics and I'm Not Kidding[/i]" ? Well then this showcase is for you![/p][p]These are games that don't bother with AAA ray-traced graphics, and cut the fat out of their narratives. [url="https://store.steampowered.com/curator/43212066/sale/shortgamesshowcase2025"]Explore the full event[/url] to find MANY discounted games that you can complete in a single evening![/p][p]A huge thank you to [url="https://store.steampowered.com/developer/ogrepixel/"]Ogre Pixel[/url] for organizing this event![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Where has Fancy Pants Man been!??[/b][/h3][p]A question we've been hearing a lot of lately...[/p][p]As we [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/668210/view/4222769301366741799"]shared a year ago[/url], Brad cracked Super FPA back open in order to optimize and improve the game. The hope was to clean the game up, improve stability on modern machines, and bring over some enhancements created for the Classic Pack. This ended up being a MUCH more challenging process than anticipated.[/p][p]In hindsight it may not have been the right time, as attempting to take this on created a massive development bottleneck for both titles. What was meant to be some casual bugfixing and optimizing quickly turned up a litany of other issues.[/p][p]Fixing one thing in Super inevitable broke two others. This quickly spun out of control, and meant needing to pour over every line of old code - all of which Brad has improved upon tenfold in the years since! Attempting to untangle that off the back of a hectic launch for Classic Pack led to developmental brickwall on both projects.[/p][p]Brad had to instead commit himself to learning Computer vision in Python in order to improve his technical abilities. This should significantly improve the process of debugging / repeated testing / uploading builds. Not very exciting stuff to provide updates on, while also largely not really being progress you can [i]show[/i].[/p][p][/p][h3][b]TL;DR[/b][/h3][p]Brad is working on massive technical improvements for Super Fancy Pants Adventures.
Currently this is limited to a [url="https://www.patreon.com/bradborne"]Pantreon[/url]-only beta branch.
When this update is completed it will be applied to the game entirely for free.
At that time, we'll be ready to move back to the Classic Pack and the future of all things Fancy Pants!

Thank you for your patience!!
-Graeme
(2 Left Thumbs)[/p]

notes.content:
[h2]The annual [b]Steam Summer Sale[/b] is here!![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29776081/985ad6d38f5cefc5597a24afbff80897c7fd6738.png[/img]

Thousands of games are on sale across Steam, including a [b]50% discount[/b] on Super Fancy Pants Adventure! Consider grabbing the game bundled with the Classic Pack for additional savings ([i]or scope out one of the other bundles offered this sale[/i]).

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/22346/The_Complete_Fancy_Pants_Adventures/

The entire [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/2leftthumbs]2 Left Thumbs[/url] publishing catalog is on sale. Be sure to browser that selection to see what other quality games might strike your [i]fancy[/i].

[h2]UPDATE?[/h2]
Brad has been hard at work on a new update for Super!! This is primarily to address performance and stability - as that has depreciated some over the last ~7 years.

This can be accessed in the [b]SFPA Beta[/b] branch:
[i]Right click the game in your Steam library > Properties > Beta tab > use code "kittenkabootle" > Check code > Select the beta in the dropdown[/i]
You should see an update initiate, which confirms it has worked!

Your feedback on this beta would be greatly appreciated!!
We wanted to have this public in time for the sale, but the current build isn't [i]quite[/i] stable enough. This update ended up being a LOT more effort than anyone was expecting! We should have more to share "soon".

[h2]COMING SOON[/h2]
A new game published by 2 Left Thumbs, hailing from another legendary Flash dev, is coming soon!

Keep an eye out for [b]Gorgon Shield[/b], from the creator of [i]Swords and Sandals[/i]. It is a party-based RPG, arcade, roguelike. And I can guarantee you haven't played another quite like it!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2446920/Gorgon_Shield/

There is large demo for you to play around in. And please be sure to add it to your [b]Wishlist[/b]!

notes.title: Classic Pack OUT NOW in Early Access!!
notes.content:
[h2]CLASSIC PACK[/h2]
The long wait is finally over!
[b]The Fancy Pants Adventures: Classic Pack[/b] has now released in [u]Early Access[/u]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1668460/The_Fancy_Pants_Adventures_Classic_Pack/

Brad has primarily developed these games out in the open for 18 years. Boxing the fans out of the development process for the Classic Pack just didn't sit well with us. Playtesters have already been critical for ensuring these Worlds [i]feel[/i] like you remember them, despite being heavily reworked and enhanced.

[h3]Early Access launch:[/h3]
"Classic" versions of Worlds 1, 2 and 3 are all available!
(Worlds 1 and 2 have received some extra polish, like 60fps enhancements, still coming to World 3)

Additional Worlds, Remasters, side-games, 100% original bonus levels, localization, achievements, a Treasure Trove of behind-the-scenes inclusions for the fans, and whatever else we can think to add will all be coming over the course of Early Access!!

[h2]BUNDLE[/h2]
If you [u]already own Super[/u], [i][b]still[/b][/i] use the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/22346/The_Complete_Fancy_Pants_Adventures/]bundle link[/url], as it will grant you an additional 20% discount on the Classic Pack, without requiring you to re-purchase Super!! (Super will be 50% off starting February 19th. Sorry that discount is out of sync).

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/22346/The_Complete_Fancy_Pants_Adventures/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29776081/98e847a341045076b2e60f8aa83d4422850ea827.png[/img][/url]

[h2]2 LEFT THUMBS[/h2]
In case you missed it, there is a second news post about this major change-up! Starting from today, 2 Left Thumbs is now the publisher of [u]both[/u] The Fancy Pants Adventures: Classic Pack AND Super Fancy Pants Adventures.

Flash games defined my childhood, and having remakes and sequels to so many of those classic titles be a part of my publishing catalog feels like a full-circle moment for me, tying together a lifetime of fandom for Flash and indie games of all kinds!

[h2]ANOTHER FLASH CLASSIC REBORN[/h2]
Maybe you played as many Flash games as I did back in the day? One of the most popular and most [i]gorgeous[/i] platformers of that time was [b]William and Sly[/b]! I am also working with series creator Lucas Paakh to bring the latest installment of his [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2684790/William_and_Sly_Classic_Collection/]classic series[/url] to Steam, reimagined as a open world, 3d platformer!

You can try the public demo now, and see if you like it. [b]William and Sly[/b] will release this Spring, so be sure to add it to your [u]Wishlists[/u]!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2459620/William_and_Sly/

notes.title: Now published by: 2 Left Thumbs
notes.content:
[h2]NEW PUBLISHER[/h2]
This has been in the works for [i]ages[/i], but as of today I can finally share publicly, that [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/2leftthumbs]2 Left Thumbs[/url] is now the publisher for [b]Super Fancy Pants Adventure[/b]!! First off, I want to thank Kongregate for their years of stewardship for all things Fancy Pants related.

For those who don't know me, my name is Graeme! I'm the founder and sole employee of 2 Left Thumbs, an indie game [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VRSiTjFrWKQ]micro-publisher[/url]. I've been a Flash game enthusiast my whole life, and grew up playing Fancy Pants! It is the absolute honor of a lifetime to now be carrying that torch <3

A few sleuths in the Discord actually figured out this was coming sooner than today, so I'm glad to finally be able to talk about it openly!

[h2]CLASSIC PACK!![/h2]
You can buy the [b]Fancy Pants Adventures: Classic Pack[/b] NOW in Early Access.
If you [u]already own Super[/u], [i][b]still[/b][/i] use the bundle link, as it will grant you an additional discount on the Classic Pack, without requiring you to re-purchase Super!!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1668460/The_Fancy_Pants_Adventures_Classic_Pack/

[h2]CHANGES[/h2]
I intend to take this role seriously. While I can't promise anything as substantial as new content, I'd like to seek out opportunities to improve the overall user experience!
[list][*]The game is bundled with the Classic Pack for an extra discount
[*] Both games now properly link to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/search/?developer=Borne%20Games]Brad's own page[/url]
[*] I've [b]localized the pricing[/b], so the game should be cheaper in many regions than it was before!
[*] There are several assets that are now considered mandatory for new Steam apps. I've added those all in! So the game should look much prettier in your library from now on
[*] General cleanup around the Steam page ([i]I've never agreed with the phrasing of "56 Levels". That should feel more accurate now[/i])[/list]
[h2]WHAT NEXT?[/h2]
I already hang out in the Fancy Pants Discord, and have been seeking inspiration for other changes we could make. Things that are already on my list (many of which will have to wait until Brad is rested, and needs a break from Classic Pack work)
[list][*] Adding Trading Cards + Badges + Backgrounds etc
[*] Pushing for full Steam Deck compatibility
[*] Removing the always-online requirement that can stop you from taking the game on the road.
[*] Adding proper key re-binding!![/list]
The main focus will remain on the Classic Pack for the foreseeable future. But please, throw some additional suggestions my way, and I'll see what can be done!

[h2]ANOTHER FLASH SEQUEL[/h2]
Maybe you played as many Flash games as I did back in the day? One of the most popular and most [i]gorgeous[/i] platformers of that time was [b]William and Sly[/b]! I am also working with series creator Lucas Paakh to bring the latest installment of his [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2684790/William_and_Sly_Classic_Collection/]classic series[/url] to Steam, reimagined as a open world, 3d platformer!

You can try the public demo now, and see if you like it. [b]William and Sly[/b] will release this Spring, so be sure to add it to your [u]Wishlists[/u]!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2459620/William_and_Sly/

notes.title: Another classic Flash series returns this Spring!
notes.content:
[h3]William and Sly 3[/h3]
Fans of Fancy Pants (and the Flash gaming golden age at large) will likely remember [b]William and Sly[/b].
A tranquil platforming adventure, where you race through nature as a fox gobbling up mushrooms and uncovering many secrets along the way.

These games are cozy, relaxing, gorgeous - and like Fancy Pants - were made [i]entirely[/i] by a solo developer! And the new game is no exception!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2459620/William_and_Sly

To show our support for a fellow Flash gaming legend, we wanted to share that brand new, 3d [b]William and Sly[/b] game is coming [u]February 26th[/u]! Be sure to try the [b]Free demo[/b] available NOW, and to add the game to your [b]Wishlist[/b]!

[previewyoutube=x3HLWPzgZps;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Classic Collection[/h3]
AND the original [b]William and Sly[/b] games are on offer entirely [u]for free[/u]. Now is the perfect time to relive these childhood games, or to get caught up ahead of the full release. Thank you for all the support you've continued to show for Flash games and their wonderful history!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2684790/William_and_Sly_Classic_Collection/

[/list]
Come check out our Discord and let us know what you think of the update, and get a look at what's coming next (https://discordapp.com/invite/aCHC493)! 

Thanks so much for playing, and we're excited to bring more to you all in the future!

notes.title: Squashing spiders (bugs too!)
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29776081/92ba823e3ab145c3b949d7e3748274172c19ae63.png[/img]

We just patched a TON of bugs in the recent update which helps with stability, quirky problems, and provides some stronger frame rates on slower machines.

If you have any more bugs, feel free to post, we're all ears and want to address as many as we can.  You can post them  [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/668210/discussions/0/1496741765132379286/]in the unofficial bug thread[/url] or if there's a larger issue feel free to create a new thread and we'll see what we can do.

Feel free to join the SFPA Discord if that's more up your alley:  https://discord.gg/bd8gXwF

Major fixes, no spoilers (thanks beta testers, Steam reports, you rock!):
[list]
    [*]White screen crash fixed for majority of players
    [*]Massive performance increases on low-mid range machines
    [*]Removed infinite-jump shooting glitch
    [*]Increased gamepad support/choices
    [*]Boss no longer soft-locks game if attacked late
    [*]House colors constrained
    [*]Health bar texture issue resolved
    [*]Exit portal on wrap level at 4:3 ratio breaking
    [*]Boss platforms on correct Z axis
    [*]Missing camera triggers in early level 3 fixed
    [*]Problem resolving hurt animation + ink pits
    [*]Controls no longer reset between doors/rooms
    [*]Block collision problems resolved
    [*]Shells now damage enemies (fun!)
    [*]Shell no longer gets stuck above top of screen
    [*]Headbutt achievement triggered now at goal instead of when combo is cleared
    [*]Getting pants twice confused the game, now fixed
    [*]Boss #2 wasn't properly resetting on second play, now fixed
    [*]Intro sequence could break if you were standing on the stairs, fixed
    [*]Portals made bigger due to rendering issues
    [*]Increased text sizes in places where hard to read
    [*]"Press Up to Enter Door" artwork looks way better now
    [*]Some events were not resetting properly on reset.  These should now all be resolved
[/list]

Thank you so much for supporting Super Fancy Pants Adventure.  We appreciate all the speedrunners, videos, let's plays, and artwork coming out!

notes.title: We're Ready.
notes.content:
Washed, rinsed, dried and... darn it, stained!  Ack, the ink from these levels are NOT coming out!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29776081/76652ff51a289690701ff40a30591d125bb9abcf.gif[/img]

We're all ready for the release of Super Fancy Pants Adventure!  Brad Borne (aka DrNeroCF) has pulled out all the stops.  This game has been years in development and we're ready to push the button to send it live!

[h1]Everything By Hand[/h1]

To give you an idea of what went into this game, Brad (with a bit of help from his team) hand-created every single level, first drawing out the stage into simple shapes and then carefully redrawing and polishing every single surface of the game.

 [img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29776081/07d7f3b6768f55edd98f88df4ce02057ae72ad06.jpg[/img]

This includes animations as well.  Each animation had to be pain-stakingly done frame-by-frame.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29776081/92ba823e3ab145c3b949d7e3748274172c19ae63.png[/img]

Its done this way on-purpose.  Ever since the first Fancy Pants game way back on web, the game has been hand-crafted.  Its a trademark of the original Flash game that follows through to the release of this title.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29776081/dde46ca17fecd7b8de7827b22898c3953eb3105f.png[/img]

[h1]Launch Date[/h1]

We're excited and proud to launch Super Fancy Pants Adventures this Wednesday.  The series has come quite a long way since it released back in 2006.  A major thanks to all the fans (especially you from Newgrounds, Armor Games, Kongregate, and now Steam) for supporting this series so passionately.  We can't wait to see you slide, jump, run, and of course, be fancy.

We're all ready for the release of Super Fancy Pants Adventure!  Brad Borne (aka DrNeroCF) has pulled out all the stops.  This game has been years in development and we're ready to push the button to send it live!

[h1]Everything By Hand[/h1]

To give you an idea of what went into this game, Brad (with a bit of help from his team) hand-created every single level, first drawing out the stage into simple shapes and then carefully redrawing and polishing every single surface of the game.

 [img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29776081/07d7f3b6768f55edd98f88df4ce02057ae72ad06.jpg[/img]

This includes animations as well.  Each animation had to be pain-stakingly done frame-by-frame.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29776081/92ba823e3ab145c3b949d7e3748274172c19ae63.png[/img]

Its done this way on-purpose.  Ever since the first Fancy Pants game way back on web, the game has been hand-crafted.  Its a trademark of the original Flash game that follows through to the release of this title.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29776081/dde46ca17fecd7b8de7827b22898c3953eb3105f.png[/img]

[h1]Launch Date[/h1]

We're excited and proud to launch Super Fancy Pants Adventures this Wednesday.  The series has come quite a long way since it released back in 2006.  A major thanks to all the fans (especially you from Newgrounds, Armor Games, Kongregate, and now Steam) for supporting this series so passionately.  We can't wait to see you slide, jump, run, and of course, be fancy.
